items.title: Willie "Old Man" Parker Interview, 1958-11-07
items.q: Oh, yeah? Yeah, Ernest Rogers? Yes.

ctx.x: I've heard of him plenty. Uh-huh. I've heard of him plenty. Ernest Rogers used to talk about him. Yeah, Ernest. Ernest used to play with you.
Oh, yeah? Yeah, Ernest Rogers? Yes. I don't tell him. Yeah. Oh, yeah. He's from down here. How did Edward Clem play?
Huh? How did Edward Clem play?
